pairs: And the Lord spoke to Moses,
and you shall say to them:
When you will have entered into the land of Canaan,
et in possessionem vobis sorte ceciderit,
and it has fallen into your possession by lot,
it shall be bound by these limits:
Pars meridiana incipiet a solitudine Sin,
The southern part shall begin from the wilderness of Sin,
et habebit terminos contra orientem mare salsissimum.
and it shall have the Sea of Salt as a limit to the east.
Qui circuibunt australem plagam per ascensum Scorpionis,
It shall circle on the south side along the ascent of the Scorpion,
by this way crossing into Senna,
et perveniant a meridie usque ad Cadesbarne,
and passing through, from the south, as far as Kadesh-barnea,
unde egredientur confinia ad villam nomine Adar,
from which its confines shall go out to the town called Adar,
Ibitque per gyrum terminus ab Asemona usque ad torrentem Ægypti,
And its limits shall go around from Azmon to the Torrent of Egypt,
and shall end at the shore of the Great Sea.
Plaga autem occidentalis a mari magno incipiet,
Then the western region shall begin from the Great Sea,
and the same shall be its end.
Porro ad septentrionalem plagam a mari magno termini incipient,
Furthermore, toward the northern region, its limits shall begin from the Great Sea,
passing through even to the highest mountain.
a quo venient in Emath usque ad terminos Sedada:
From there, it limits shall advance into Hamath, as far as the limits of Zedad.
And its confines shall go all the way to Ziphron,
and to the village of Enan.
Hi erunt termini in parte aquilonis.
These shall be the limits on the northern side.
Inde metabuntur fines contra orientalem plagam de villa Enan usque Sephama,
From there, its limits shall be measured, facing the east side, from the village of Enan as far as Shepham.
et de Sephama descendent termini in Rebla contra fontem Daphnim: inde pervenient contra orientem ad mare Cenereth,
And from Shepham, the boundaries shall descend into Riblah, opposite the fountain of Daphnis. From there, the boundaries shall pass through, opposite the east, to the Sea of Chinnereth,
and shall extend as far as the Jordan, and,
et ad ultimum salsissimo claudentur mari.
at the furthest extent, shall be enclosed by the Sea of Salt.
Hanc habebitis terram per fines suos in circuitu.
You shall have this land, with its borders all around.”
And Moses instructed the sons of Israel,
Hæc erit terra, quam possidebitis sorte,
“This shall be the land which you shall possess by lot,
et quam jussit Dominus dari novem tribubus,
and which the Lord has ordered to be given to the nine tribes,
Tribus enim filiorum Ruben per familias suas,
For the tribe of the sons of Ruben, by their families,
et tribus filiorum Gad juxta cognationum numerum,
and the tribe of the sons of Gad, according to the number of their kinships,
and also one half of the tribe of Manasseh,
acceperunt partem suam trans Jordanem contra Jericho ad orientalem plagam.
have received their portion across the Jordan, opposite Jericho, toward the eastern side.”
And the Lord said to Moses:
Hæc sunt nomina virorum qui terram vobis divident,
“These are the names of the men, who shall divide the land for you:
and Joshua the son of Nun,
et singuli principes de tribubus singulis,
and one leader from each tribe,
from the tribe of the sons of Dan,
of the sons of Joseph, from the tribe of Manasseh,
Paltiel the leader, the son of Azzan;
Hi sunt, quibus præcepit Dominus ut dividerent filiis Israël terram Chanaan.
These are the ones that the Lord has ordered to divide the land of Canaan to the sons of Israel.
